scope: internal/broker: the record of a consumer that a subscription puts again
correction: A subscription that was put again overwrote its consumer's last known position with the consumer's current 1. A client whose pull had passed a retention gap therefore lost the only record of that gap, and got no resync event. The birth of a consumer now records its position only when there is none, or when the new 1 is lower: an update never raises the record.
evidence: cross-review of frostyard/lodge#96 at a0d5c6a: SubscribeWith overwrote the position record of an existing consumer
